brief: Build a professional but playful employee experience platform for a 500-person technology company. The marketing site should feel warm and energetic, while the application itself should feel professional, fast and trustworthy. Make the dashboard refined, make onboarding playful, keep settings conservative.

directions.cardText:
DIRECTION 01
Conservative Fit
Calm Foundation

Closest to inferred product priors with standard sidebar navigation, reinforced accessibility floors, and rock-solid predictable ergonomics.
